old_problem: A suite status alone did not prove per-GPU InfoROM integrity or unchanged persistent metadata, and the source inverted service order while DeepSeek narrowed evidence to level 1.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA defines the InfoROM software check and `DCGM_FR_CORRUPT_INFOROM`. Per-GPU identity/health before and after the read-only run plus full level-4 accounting yields a complete safe oracle.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row360 all 18 XLSX columns and history2955.
Applied official DCGM InfoROM software-check semantics.
No InfoROM read/write command, service change or diagnostic occurred.

test_case.test_name: DCGM level-4 InfoROM integrity check with immutable metadata identity
test_case.purpose: Verify every selected GPU reports healthy readable InfoROM through DCGM and that no persistent identity, object version or health state changes during the read-only diagnostic.
required_package: Compatible GPU/driver/DCGM matrix and entity manifest
test_case.test_command: Capture supported per-UUID InfoROM identity/version/health fields and preserve logs; establish approved DCGM state, run one full level-4 suite without any repair/write operation, record the InfoROM check and all tests/skips, recapture identical fields, then restore runtime state.
test_case.expected_result: Each supported InfoROM is readable and unchanged, the named check passes without `DCGM_FR_CORRUPT_INFOROM`, unsupported fields are explicitly classified rather than passed, and all expected level-4 tests pass.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the named check plus unchanged per-GPU supported metadata and complete suite accounting; any corruption, unexplained change or unclassified skip prevents PASS.
safety_gate: Strict read-only scope; no InfoROM repair or flash
Stop on corruption/mismatch and never retry automatically
expected_evidence: Pre/post supported InfoROM fields and health
InfoROM result code and unsupported-field decisions
test_case.recovery: On mismatch or corruption indication, stop without repair or rerun, isolate the affected GPU, restore only runtime service/persistence state, preserve evidence and escalate through the vendor-authorized recovery path.

source_conflict.reason: The documented named check and immutable no-write comparison supply the title oracle; cumulative level 4 and pre-run service state resolve the level/order conflict.
